text: The City Clerk's Office received notice that Robert Allsopp has resigned from the Toronto Preservation Board effective April 14, 2024. Staff from the Public Appointments Secretariat in the City Clerk's Office are leading a process to recruit applicants and a nominated candidate will be considered by City Council for appointment at its meeting on May 22-24, 2024.
The Toronto Preservation Board accepted the resignation of Robert Allsopp as member effective April 14, 2024.
